description.value: The Mainstay is the central bar of British Columbia's first licensed food hall, anchoring 18 independent food kitchens inside the Lonsdale Quay Market on North Vancouver's waterfront. Opened in January 2026, it serves BC craft beers on draft, a curated wine list, cocktails, and alcohol-free options alongside a live music program. The food hall format gives touring cyclists rolling in off the SeaBus a rare combination of a proper licensed bar and access to a wide variety of food vendors all under one roof.
